reader.requirement: At --std 85 the page heading is the first group on every page, except that (a) it is not processed on a page holding only a report heading (NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE) or only a report footing (LINE NEXT PAGE), and (b) it is second, after a report heading that is not on a page by itself, placed from that heading's final LINE-COUNTER.

reader.notes: The RH NEXT PAGE arm (ApplyNextGroup, ReportHeading default) and the RF LINE NEXT PAGE arm (PresentHeadingFooting ownPage) take a bare PageFeed with no page heading; every body-group page advance (AdvancePage) presents PF, feed, PH. _rhOnThisPage is set only when the RH printed, so a SUPPRESSed RH leaves the PH first at HEADING, as ptype1 shows.

refuter.evidence: rtype1-001 R1: an RH not alone with NEXT GROUP PLUS 1 put the PH on L3 (RH final LC 2 + 1) as the second group, and on page 2 the PH LINE PLUS 1 printed first on L1 (HEADING 1). rtype1 R2: PH LINE 2 absolute on each page with no RH. rtype1 R3: the page holding only RH (NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE) had no PH; pages 2 and 3 (page 3 opened by a TERMINATE CF overflow) had PH3 first on L1. rtype2-003: an absolute PH LINE 3 after an RH with absolute NEXT GROUP 2 printed on L3. rtype3-001 R2: a nonprintable PH ran its USE on each page and left LC 0.
